$$
X(s)=\frac{4s^3+3s^2-20s+11}{s^2+s-6}
$$
Determine the FS representation of the signal shown in Fig. 1C.

questions.markdown:
Use the following clues to determine the impulse response $h[n]$ and the transfer function $H(z)$:

$H(z)$ has poles at $z=1/3$ and $z=-1$, $h[1]=1/2$, $h[-1]=2$ and ROC includes the point $z=3/4$.

A rectangular pulse is defined by

$$
x(t)=\begin{cases}
A, & 0\le t\le T\\
0, & \text{Otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$

It is applied to an integrator defined by

$$
y(t)=\int_0^t x(\tau)\,d\tau
$$

Determine the energy spectral density of (i) $x(t)$ and (ii) $y(t)$.

questions.markdown:
Certain discrete time LTI system has impulse response

$$
h[n]=\frac{1}{4}\delta[n]+\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^n u[n]-2\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^n u[n-1].
$$

Write the difference equation representing this system. Use frequency domain analysis to determine the input required to produce an output of

$$
y[n]=\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^n u[n]+\frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^n u[n]
$$

for this system.

Certain continuous time LTI system has impulse response

$$
h(t)=\frac{\sin\left(\frac{5\pi t}{2}\right)}{\pi t}.
$$

Use FT to determine the system output if the input is periodic rectangular wave with period $T=2$ defined by

$$
x(t)=\begin{cases}
1, & |t|\le 0.5\\
0, & 0.5<|t|\le T/2
\end{cases}
$$

Consider two discrete time signals

$$
x[n]=\begin{cases}
1, & 0\le n\le 3\\
-1, & 4\le n\le 7\\
0, & \text{elsewhere}
\end{cases}
$$

$$
h[n]=\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^n u[n].
$$

Let $y[n]=x[n]*h[n]$ where $*$ denote convolution sum. Determine $y[3]$, $y[5]$ and $y[8]$.

Consider the discrete time system depicted in the figure Q4A. Let

$$
h[n]=\frac{\sin\left(\frac{n\pi}{2}\right)}{n\pi}.
$$

Determine the output response $y[n]$ for the input, $x[n]=\delta[n]-\frac{\sin\left(\frac{n\pi}{2}\right)}{n\pi}$, and $w[n]=(-1)^n$.
Also sketch $G(e^{j\Omega})$ and $Y(e^{j\Omega})$.

questions.markdown:
Sketch the signal $w[n]=x[3-n]\cdot y[-2-n]$ if

$$
x[n]=\{3,1,2,1,2,1,3\}
$$

and

$$
y[n]=\{-1,-1,-1,-1,0,1,1,1,1\}
$$

Also sketch the even and odd components of $w[n]$.

questions.markdown:
Determine and sketch the power spectral density (PSD) of the signal

$$
x[n]=1+\cos\left(\frac{10(n-3)\pi}{19}\right)+2\sin\left(\frac{14(n-3)\pi}{19}\right).
$$

Determine the average power of $x[n]$ using its PSD.

Consider sampling the signal:

$$
x(t)=\cos(\omega_0 t),
$$

with a sampling interval of $T_s=1/4$ seconds. For each of the following cases, plot the spectrum of the sampled signal and identify whether aliasing occurs:

a. $\omega_0=6\pi$ radians/second

b. $\omega_0=4\pi$ radians/second

c. $\omega_0=2\pi$ radians/second

Using properties, find the Fourier representation of

$$
x[n]=2j\,n\,e^{j\frac{\pi}{6}n},\ |n|\le 4
$$

Given the transfer function:

$$
H(z)=\frac{1+z^{-1}}{1-\frac{3}{4}z^{-1}+\frac{1}{8}z^{-2}}
$$

Draw the pole-zero plot of the transfer function and specify the region of convergence to ensure the system satisfies both causality and stability conditions. Hence, determine the impulse response of the system.
